name: simple-english-dictionary
description: Simple and intuitive English dictionary browser extension for instant word lookup on double-click (Chrome & Firefox).

scripts.lint: npm run build:firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.start: npm run build:firefox && web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.start:chrome:
npm run build:chrome && echo '
👉 Open chrome://extensions, enable Developer mode, and click Load Unpacked -> dist/chrome'
scripts.package:chrome: npm run build:chrome && node scripts/package.js chrome
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && node scripts/package.js firefox
scripts.package:all: npm run build && node scripts/package.js all

author: Omkar Shetkar
